purpose: Read me first. Every Sanskrit asset, tool, doc and endpoint in one file, with the MCP tool that reaches it, and ready-made plugin recipes.

live.auth: Bearer (token on the box at /etc/svatantrya-mcp.env; 401 without)

rules: BLOCKED != PASS. If a check cannot run, say BLOCKED and why.
Machine traces are DERIVED, not truth.
Never invent Sanskrit. A form not in the corpus does not render.
Missing means not in the data, never that the tradition is silent.
